title: The OLE2 whole-stream zero-fill ceiling, measured natively, and the frozen appending-read design
decision: design retained, implementation declined on the measured ceiling
code_state: no file under crates/ was modified by this batch
reason_codes: change 0587 ranked CFB-1 on a retained callgrind share of 9-32% of DOC and PPT open instructions and wrote its own falsification criterion: falsified if a cycles A/B of the DOC and PPT opens on an owned source sits inside the 4% p50 floor

measured natively on this host, the zero-fill is 1.88% of the 1.6 MB DOC eager open, 0.57% of the 335 KB DOC eager open, 2.84% of the eager PPT open, 2.68% of the source-backed PPT open and 2.94% of the source-backed XLS open in cycles, and 0.29% to 1.88% in instructions; inside 4% on every fixture, so the criterion is met and the item is declined
the callgrind share it was ranked on counts rep stosb once per byte: 1,595,476 Ir retained against 44,925 instructions measured natively for the same work on the same fixture, a 35x overstatement

the safe shape helps only sources that own contiguous bytes; no stable positional API accepts uninitialized memory, so FileSource and every File-backed reader keep today's zero-fill, and those are the routes Package::open, SourceBackedWorkbook::from_path and SourceBackedPackage::from_path take
the design is written out in full anyway, because twenty-one items in the 0587 queue need a frozen design record and this one is now available without re-deriving it

accepted_evidence.byte_counts: exact bytes zero-filled per open at every u8 zero-fill site in litchi-cfb and at the litchi-xls globals buffer, from instrumented single opens on owned in-memory sources: 1,623,070 for the 1.6 MB DOC eager open (1,595,422 of it three slurped streams), 323,850 for the 335 KB DOC, 360,903 for the eager PPT, 322,788 for the source-backed PPT, 565,713 for the source-backed XLS (551,377 of it the XLS globals buffer across 20 fills, and no CFB stream slurp at all)
accepted_evidence.native_cycles: perf stat cycles and instructions per operation for the five opens and for the memset, zero+copy, append and allocation-only micro-benchmarks at each fixture's byte counts; isolation pairs at 10 and 110 samples, median of 11 repetitions, taskset -c 19
accepted_evidence.aa_floor: two A/A controls in the same window: 0.44% and 0.29% apart on the isolation-pair cycle metric, and a wall-clock paired A/A of 60 samples per leg in A1 B1 B2 A2 order whose p50 legs differ by -0.06%, +0.00% and +0.26%
accepted_evidence.gates: cargo fmt --all --check, clippy on litchi-cfb, litchi-core and litchi-xls with all targets, cargo test -p litchi-cfb (322 + 13 + 6 + 12 passed, 0 failed), the three named truncated-final-sector parity tests, and cargo doc on the three crates, all on the clean worktree at the base commit

accepted_costs.ceiling_not_delta: every percentage is a micro-benchmark of the same byte counts divided by a measured open, so it bounds the term rather than measuring it in place; the realizable saving is strictly smaller and is not measured, because nothing was implemented
accepted_costs.owned_sources_only: every open measured wraps bytes already in memory; no file-backed leg exists because the design cannot change one
accepted_costs.warm_heap: the slurp micro-benchmarks allocate and free in a tight loop, so the allocator reuses a warm block after the first iterations; their absolute figures are warm-heap numbers, equally so on both legs
accepted_costs.shared_host: seven other agents were building and measuring on the same 32-core host throughout; the XLS A/A p95 and p99 are 1.8x to 2.2x its p50 on both legs because of it

known_gaps.corpus: no OLE2 fixture above 1.6 MB, none with a DIFAT sector and none with 4,096-byte sectors exists in this repository (0587's census over 212 fixtures); a synthetic large or v4 fixture could move the ceiling and none was built
known_gaps.selectors: no registered perf-baseline selector times a DOC or PPT open, so the opens were measured through a scratch probe with path dependencies, retained in this packet
known_gaps.unproven_design_part: Part 3a of the design replaces read_exact with take().read_to_end() on the eager reader, which reports a short read as Ok(n) where read_exact raises UnexpectedEof; its error-identity proof over the malformed corpus is the first thing a future batch must do
known_gaps.not_sized: the try_reserve_exact realloc pattern in GlobalsBuffer::ensure is recorded as a mechanism with no size; whether it costs a copy per fill depends on whether the allocator can mremap the block

withheld: any speedup, regression, file-backed, range-source, cold-cache, peak-RSS, allocation-count, concurrency-scaling or cross-platform result
any statement about DOC, PPT or XLS opens outside the five fixtures named
any conclusion about CFB-2 to CFB-6, XLS-6 or the other items 0587 ranks near this one

provenance.host: AMD EPYC 9R45, 32 cores, 123 GiB, Linux 7.0.0-1012-aws, rustc 1.95.0, cargo 1.95.0, perf available
provenance.note: all work was done in a detached worktree with its own target directory; the instrumentation used for the byte counts was applied, captured and reverted, and the tree was verified clean before the gates and the commit
